name: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off v. 2
description: A variation of the seated overhead press and Russian twist combo with feet off the floor. It works the trunk and shoulders.
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them.
Twist your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest tall and breathe steadily.
